mapper.insert: INSERT INTO narration_requests (id, project_id, chapter_id, chapter_row_version, source_hash, source_text, voice_id, language, speaking_rate, segmentation_version, request_fingerprint, project_voice_reference_asset_id, account_voice_reference_asset_id) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{chapterId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{chapterRowVersion}, #{sourceHash}, #{sourceText}, #{voiceId}, #{language}, #{speakingRate}, #{segmentationVersion}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{projectVoiceReferenceAssetId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{accountVoiceReferenceAssetId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}) ON CONFLICT (request_fingerprint) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, chapter_id, chapter_row_version, source_hash, source_text, voice_id, language, speaking_rate, segmentation_version, request_fingerprint, project_voice_reference_asset_id, account_voice_reference_asset_id FROM narration_requests WHERE request_fingerprint = #{requestFingerprint}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO narration_operations (id, narration_request_id, generation_job_id, stage_attempt_id) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{narrationRequestId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{generationJobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{stageAttemptId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT pa.storage_key AS storageKey, pa.mime_type AS contentType, na.duration_ms AS durationMs FROM generation_jobs gj JOIN projects p ON p.id = gj.project_id JOIN narration_operations no ON no.generation_job_id = gj.id JOIN narration_requests nr ON nr.id = no.narration_request_id JOIN narration_assets na ON na.narration_request_id = nr.id JOIN project_assets pa ON pa.id = na.project_asset_id WHERE gj.job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND gj.project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND p.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND gj.job_type = 'NARRATION_GENERATE' AND gj.status = 'COMPLETED' AND gj.idempotency_key LIKE 'voice-preview:%' AND pa.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pa.storage_key IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1
